FISHING LICENCE · CANADA

Northwest Territories fishing licence

Visitors generally need an NWT sport fishing licence. Great Bear Lake and the Inuvialuit Settlement Region require additional authorization.

Official rules ↗

Updated 2026-11-13

Who needs one

  • Visiting anglers who do not meet an age or other exemption.

Who doesn’t

  • Canadian residents under 16 or aged 65 and older qualify for the stated age exemptions.
  • Foreign children under 16 can fish with a valid licence holder; confirm special-area conditions.

Licence options and prices

LicenceForLengthPrice
Canadian visitor seasonnon residentUntil March 31$25.86 CAD
Canadian visitor 3-daynon resident3 days$19.39 CAD
Foreign visitor seasonnon residentUntil March 31$51.73 CAD
Foreign visitor 3-daynon resident3 days$38.80 CAD
Visitor 1-daynon resident1 day$12.93 CAD

Extra stamps and permits

  • Great Bear Lake authorization · $12.93 CAD
    Required in addition to the standard licence, regardless of age or residency.
  • Inuvialuit Settlement Region authorization · $0 CAD
    Required in addition to the standard licence, regardless of age or residency.
  • National park permit
    An NWT licence is not valid in a national park.
  • Edéhzhíe National Wildlife Area permit
    Required in addition to an NWT sport fishing licence inside the wildlife area.

Rules visitors should know

  • Carry the licence.
  • Use barbless hooks.
  • Stay within daily and possession limits.

How to buy

Buy through NWT eServices or a participating licence outlet.

Common license questions

Do I need a fishing licence in Northwest Territories?

Visitors generally need an NWT sport fishing licence. Great Bear Lake and the Inuvialuit Settlement Region require additional authorization.

How much is a visitor fishing licence in Northwest Territories?

Canadian visitor season: $25.86 CAD; Canadian visitor 3-day: $19.39 CAD; Foreign visitor season: $51.73 CAD; Foreign visitor 3-day: $38.80 CAD (checked November 2026).

Where do I buy a fishing licence in Northwest Territories?

Buy through NWT eServices or a participating licence outlet.
